name: Metaculus FutureEval
description: Metaculus FutureEval is a continuously updated live forecasting benchmark that resists data contamination because the answers to questions are not yet known at evaluation time. It offers $175K in annual prizes for bot tournaments, incentivizing development of probabilistically calibrated AI forecasters on real-world outcomes.
reputation: Emerging benchmark backed by the established Metaculus forecasting community; the competitive prize structure and contamination resistance make it significant for frontier LLM evaluation.
notes: Contamination-resistant by design: questions concern future events whose resolutions are unknown at eval time. Annual $175K prize pool for automated bot tournaments. Distinct from the Metaculus platform card (metaculus.json), which describes the broader prediction community.
